text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) had finally arrived.
At the paddock, snippets of conversation from the crowd
happened to catch my ear.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"All right, it's finally here, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
I've been soooo looking forward to this~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, it's a race packed with the absolute strongest contenders on the Senior Classic route.
You'd have to be crazy not to look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's part of it, sure! But you see,
Marvelous Sunday is running, right?
—So, that's another reason why.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's just something... mysterious about her.
I mean, obviously she's strong, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"They put on a 'great race', plain and simple.
Not just for us watching... even the girls running look like they're having a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
And, it's really strange, but—
the girls who run with her always, well... start heading toward the light.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Like, maybe girls who got tired of racing,
or who felt like they hit a wall recently...
it helps them feel a little more positive."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Races are just fun after all,’ she'd say, 
and she started showing that wonderful smile of hers again."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's why I, well... kind of love
Marvelous Sunday's races!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh... What a strange girl.
Whoa, hey! Speak of the devil, Marvelous Sunday is here!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyoooone☆★☆
MAAARVELOOOUUUS★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!!
MARRRVELLLLOOOUUUS!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You sure know how to whip up an incredible storm of excitement, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wah, whoa, Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we get to run together today☆
That's amazing, a total miracle★☆★

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You sure are enjoying yourself.
Though, I suppose that is where your strength lies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To ignite even a smoldering entertainer's fire—
As the "Empress," I shall see your true worth.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, I'll also—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, we're going to run together.
So... take care of me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Suzukaaa~~~!!
Yes, yes, yes! Let's do this☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's run! Let's all run together!!
Feel all the Marvelous in me!!
